slo_title: Contrast machine code with high-level programming languages

mcq.q: In terms of abstraction, how does object-oriented programming (OOP) differ from procedural programming?

options.A: a) OOP hides data and behavior inside objects
options.B: b) Procedural programming focuses only on objects
options.C: c) Procedural programming supports classes and inheritance ​​​​​​​ ​​​​​​​
options.D: d) OOP uses less abstraction than procedural

mcq.answer_text: a) OOP hides data and behavior inside objects

mcq.q: Which of the following best describes machine code?

options.A: a) A language written in English-like syntax
options.B: b) Human-readable code used for algorithms
options.C: c) Binary code executed directly by the CPU ​​​​​​​ ​​​​​​​
options.D: d) Code used only in web development

mcq.answer_text: c) Binary code executed directly by the CPU ​​​​​​​ ​​​​​​​

mcq.q: What is a key difference between machine code and high-level languages?

options.A: a) Machine code is written for readability
options.B: b) High-level languages are not translated
options.D: d) High-level languages are more abstract and easier to read

mcq.answer_text: d) High-level languages are more abstract and easier to read

mcq.q: Which feature of object-oriented programming supports abstraction?
How does procedural programming approach abstraction?

options.B: b) By organizing code into reusable functions
options.D: d) By hiding methods inside classes

mcq.answer_text: b) By organizing code into reusable functions

sq.q: A company needs to summarize sales per region. How can declarative processing achieve this?
answer: A GROUP BY query aggregates results based on regions, allowing simple and effective extraction of summary data without imperative code.

sq.q: A report must retrieve students who scored above 85% in Math. How does declarative programming support this task?
answer: A SQL query like SELECT * FROM Students WHERE score > 85 AND subject = 'Math' specifies the desired result directly without manual control structures.

lq.q: A school system requires a list of students who scored above 90 in all subjects . Provide an SQL query for this and explain how the declarative paradigm simplifies the task.
answer: SELECT student_id FROM marks GROUP BY student_id HAVING MIN(score) > 90;
